A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the first analysis for crowd-based object segmentation and propose a method to improve the quality of the crowd-based annotations.

we are the first who show how to use clickstream data to estimate the quality for crowd-sourced image annotation and that we are the only one who show how to improve crowd-sourcing for image segmentation.

The main takeaway from our work is that
clickstream data is a valuable source of information for quality control and can be used to estimate the confidence of a crowd-based image segmentation.
clickstream data contains a lot of information about the annotator's behavior and that this information can be exploited to improve crowd-based segmentation.
